jobs.name: 초원 협곡
jobs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit, background variation.
Edit the attached centered RUSHITADEL pixel-art title image. Output ONE full 16:9 menu screenshot.
CHANGE BACKGROUND ONLY. ABSOLUTELY preserve the foreground UI: RUSHITADEL logo's exact center position, size, pale mint color, block pixel font; all four buttons' exact positions, dimensions, pixel icons, thin borders, spacing, colors and selection state. Text exactly "게임 시작", "이어하기", "설정", "게임 종료". First button mint filled, second disabled gray. Do NOT redesign the logo/buttons. No other words or UI.
Also keep the same four red-core robot enemies (one large and one small on each side) in the same positions and sizes, on raised plateau ground; keep small five-turret violet player at bottom center on the lower central road. No new characters. The enemy plateaus are above the middle lane; rock faces descend inward. This spatial relation persists in all variants.
Replace only environment with the specific background described below. Foreground UI must be highest contrast. Background is softly subdued in VALUE and SATURATION, clearly behind the menu, but still readable, never almost black. NO BLUR. End-to-end genuine crisp PIXEL ART, hard square clusters, matte palette, clean and uncluttered, restrained detail. No glossy 3D, no smooth vector background, no photoreal fog, no decorative frames, no busy small particles, no watermark. Keep central background dark navy quiet and uninterrupted behind the existing UI. Do not add bright details behind words. One image not contact sheet.
Specific background: Both raised outer banks become a cohesive muted sage grassland, with sparse short grass tufts and a few gray boulders; remove ice, lava, water and tall trees. Medium-height simple chunky mossy rock cliff faces frame the central lower navy-slate dirt road. Calm dusk green palette, low contrast, no dense forest. The four existing enemies stay visibly on upper grass. Pixel terrain detail is reduced to half the source, so the central menu dominates.
